font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<div style="font-size:0"><span style="font-size:14px">restored and visible</span></div>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
